subject: perf(Breadcrumbs): rebuild overflow menu for fewer renders, cheaper layout and better SSR (#8683)

Breadcrumbs: Improve the performance of `overflow="menu"` and `"menu-with-root"` on mount, resize and navigation. Server-rendered markup now applies the collapse rules before hydration, and the overflow menu trigger is a `<button>`.
